description: Owner-authorized Apify collection for registered YouTube liquid primary query Δ9-THCH リキッド. Each query is a separate run and sample; counts are not combined. Raw retention follows raw-social-default (git_untracked/private); publication is not authorized by this declaration.

runs.purpose: Owner-authorized collection for the registered primary query Δ9-THCH リキッド (delta9-thch-liquid-ja); the exact query string is the measured unit and does not establish verified chemical identity.

collection_request.actor_input_basis: Submitted verbatim through netloom Apify run; checked the returned input field equals the registered canonical query and all returned rows have type=video.
collection_request.date_filter_basis: No dateFilter was supplied; all is the declaration vocabulary for this unbounded request, not an actor enum.

temporal.boundary_semantics: Observed video publish-date range from returned record date values, normalized to a half-open UTC day interval; not a request window.
limitations: The search request omitted dateFilter and has no absolute publish-date window.
This is a search-result sample capped by maxResults=500, not a census; a successful actor run does not establish completeness of all matching videos.
No geographic filter is applied. Japanese リキッド is a query-language approximation only, not a geo restriction.

timestamps.basis: Apify actor run status object queried through netloom apify run-status; timestamps are the actor run UTC values.

environment.actor_build_basis: buildNumber and buildId from the Apify run status object queried via netloom.
environment.payload_shape: JSON array of flat YouTube video records; one search input and type=video per record.

observed_range.derivation: min/max of the payload date field, converted to UTC; window bounds are half-open UTC day normalization of these observations.

deduplication.note: Uniqueness checked within this raw payload; no in-place deduplication applied.
